infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Grove listens when you press your ring, so you can talk to it through your glasses.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Grove turns what you say into text so it can answer. Speech stays on this device unless you turn that off in Settings.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Grove uses your glasses and ring once you have paired them in iOS Settings.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Grove reads your day out and moves things when you ask it to.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Grove reads your day out and moves things when you ask it to.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Grove saves the things you ask it to remember.
infoPlist.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: Grove saves the things you ask it to remember.
